acceptance_criteria: Given an unauthenticated user, When valid instructor or student credentials are submitted, Then a JWT session token is returned with corresponding role permissions.
Given an authenticated instructor, When they create a quiz with title and 4 options with 1 marked correct, Then the quiz is persisted with a unique quiz ID.
Given a created quiz, When the instructor clicks Launch Session, Then a unique 6-character room code is generated and session state is set to WAITING.

item: Student lobby join via room code
acceptance_criteria: Given an active session in WAITING state, When a student enters the valid room code, Then the student is connected and their name appears on the lobby screen.
Given connected students in a session, When the instructor triggers question display, Then the question text and answer choices broadcast to all clients within 500 ms over WebSocket.
Given a broadcast question with a 30-second duration, When countdown begins, Then timers tick synchronously across screens and answer submissions lock at 0 seconds.
Given an active question countdown, When a student selects and submits an answer choice, Then the server records the submission timestamp and returns a success acknowledgment.
